hallazgos.detalle: El Service Role describe mantenimiento de datos de referencia, no la acción de acceder y visualizar datos personales y de contacto.
El objeto central 'pantalla de datos personales' no tiene ningún Service Domain con rol OWNED.
El dominio 'Customer Workbench' podría cubrir la acción de acceder a la pantalla de datos personales pero está descartado.

revision_adversarial.resumen: Se detectan inconsistencias: el Service Role de Party Reference Data Directory no coincide con la acción directa, falta un Service Domain que posea la pantalla de datos personales y se omitió evaluar Customer Workbench como candidato.

candidatos_directos.accion_objeto: acceder y visualizar datos personales y de contacto
candidatos_directos.justificacion: La historia requiere recuperar y visualizar los datos de referencia y de contacto del usuario (celular, correo, nombre, identificación), lo cual coincide exactamente con la responsabilidad de administrar y proveer la entidad Reference en Party Reference Data Directory.
candidatos_directos.rol_bian: The party reference data directory service domain maintains a potentially wide range of party reference data that might be used in any interaction between the bank and the party including relationship development, sales/marketing, servicing and product delivery. This can include general reference and contact details, party associations, demographic details and some servicing preferences. Different information may be maintained for different party types such as individuals, corporates, partners

operaciones_bian.justificacion: Retrieve personal and contact info for display

observaciones_adversariales: [adversarial] El Service Role describe mantenimiento de datos de referencia, no la acción de acceder y visualizar datos personales y de contacto.
[adversarial] El objeto central 'pantalla de datos personales' no tiene ningún Service Domain con rol OWNED.
evidence_refs: The party reference data directory service domain maintains a potentially wide range of party reference data... general reference and contact details

candidatos_descartados.justificacion: La historia requiere que el usuario esté autenticado como precondición de acceso a la pantalla de datos personales, pero la historia no administra ni evalúa la autenticación del usuario. Por tanto, Party Authentication es únicamente una dependencia consumida de seguridad.
candidatos_descartados.rol_bian: Customer/party authentication is a cross-channel/device capability that provides identity confirmation for customers accessing the bank through any interactive channel. The service may use a combination of one or more mechanisms to authenticate including issued tokens/devices, virtual mechanisms such as passwords and biometrics such as voice/face recognition. Different levels of authentication may be determined to support different types of access and there may be access permissions associated with the authentication mechanism used
observaciones_adversariales: Revisar ownership: correspondencia fuerte con catalogo oficial.
evidence_refs: Customer/party authentication is a cross-channel/device capability that provides identity confirmation for customers accessing the bank through any interactive channel.

candidatos_descartados.justificacion: Customer Workbench se encarga del funcionamiento, sesiones y configuración de la aplicación/dispositivo cliente. La historia requiere consultar y presentar los datos personales y de contacto del cliente en pantalla, un objeto de negocio distinto a la gestión del entorno operativo del dispositivo.
candidatos_descartados.rol_bian: This service domain handles the distribution and operation of a client device based/resident facility to support local working and access to the banks different products and services. It allows for the customer to maintain information and configuration settings remotely to govern their own access environment as necessary. The service domain operates outside the bank but is included in the landscape as it may run application capabilities that are either provided by or certified for use by the bank.
observaciones_adversariales: [adversarial] El dominio 'Customer Workbench' podría cubrir la acción de acceder a la pantalla de datos personales pero está descartado.

candidatos_descartados.justificacion: La historia de usuario describe la visualización y acceso a la edición de datos personales y de contacto en una pantalla de perfil. El Service Domain 'Transaction Authorization' se encarga de mitigar el riesgo de transacciones y autorizar accesos interactivos mediante análisis de fraude, lo cual no tiene relación directa ni de dependencia con la visualización de datos de perfil del cliente.
candidatos_descartados.rol_bian: This service domain is used to mitigate transaction risk for interactive product and service access fulfillment and works in collaboration with customer identity authentication services. It analyses recent customer activity in order to detect possible out of pattern/fraudulent behavior and authorizes transactions accordingly. The authorization can be subject to obtaining increased levels of customer authentication by requiring the customer to provide additional proof of identity.

candidatos_descartados.accion_objeto: acceder a pantalla de datos personales
candidatos_descartados.justificacion: La historia gestiona la visualización y edición de datos personales, mientras el dominio Correspondence se centra en la generación y gestión de correspondencia; no hay coincidencia de verbo ni de objeto de negocio en las operaciones o esquemas del paquete.
candidatos_descartados.rol_bian: This service domain handles the automated generation of (batches of) pre-formatted correspondence. It also handles the tracking of expected responses to sent out mail requests and handles the matching of the response and the onward routing of these and all unsolicited inbound correspondence.

escenarios_hu: Maintain a record of transactions and events related to Partners to support settlement, reconciliatin and performance tracking.
candidatos_descartados.justificacion: La historia solicita acceder y visualizar la pantalla de datos personales e información de contacto del usuario. 'Operations Log' administra registros de transacciones y eventos de Partners (PartnerEventLog), no teniendo relación funcional directa ni consumo de dependencias con la visualización de perfil personal.

evidence_refs: Maintain a record of transactions and events related to Partners to support settlement, reconciliatin and performance tracking.

candidatos_descartados.justificacion: No operations or schemas in Customer Access Entitlement match the story's verbs or objects.

It is referenced for channel access control and utilization limits that may span multiple products. For example there can be a limit on total ATM withdrawals for a customer for all active products over a 24 hour period.

Processing can include verification and authorizations steps and the invoice could be issued as a single transaction or a schedule of transactions.

Case resolution tasks follow specific procedures for the type of case involved. Case resolution can be quick by applying resolution rules and obtaining additional authorization as necessary, or they can be long living activities, for example where documentation is requested and has to be retrieved from merchants or other interested parties before the disputed issue can finally be ruled upon. This service domain administers customer consents for their preferences and constraints on accepting direct debit collection requests, request to pay against their accounts held at the bank, or preferences for credit transfer (e.g. payment rail, preferred funding account, etc.)

It references the Product Directory for the product specific offer instructions it must follow. The offer process may combine the selection of product/service specific details (e.g. pricing & negotiation ranges, documentation/authorization/regulatory requirements, eligibility and declarations, credit and other customer details), customer specific details (e.g. credit standing, other classifications such as operational overhead/retention target/activity history, demographics and segmentation). The service domain orchestrates a potentially complex/multi-threaded/multi stage workflow to get the offer to the point where the product/service can be initiated.
